options.better_fit: Use object detection when bounding boxes are needed.

feedback.intrinsic: The checkout plan would ask a classification task for location output it does not provide.
feedback.instructional: Use image classification for naming one main item; use object detection when bounding boxes are required.

payload.feedback_for_correct: Correct. The right choice depends on whether the need is one label, object regions, or precise pixels.
